notes.subject: ישרון
notes.rationale: Yisherun: nem bilong Yisrael (KJV 'bilong Yisherun') o saveim tok long Yisrael yet (ASV/JPS 'o Yisherun'); mi bihainim KJV/BSB.

notes.subject: שחקים
notes.rationale: shakim: 'ol klaut bilong skai / klaut pisin'; mining i 'pulim win, kago ol man i kilim i kamap ol smol smol' — 'ol klaut' em piksa bilong heven.

notes.subject: גאותו
notes.rationale: ga'avto: i stap namel — 'biknem/glori' bilong El na 'haitensa heart' bilong man; Tok Pisin 'biknem' i holim tupela.

translation: I no gat ⟨wanpela⟩ olsem El, ye Yisherun; em i raidim ⟨סמן:heven⟩ ol heven long helpim yu, na long biknem bilong em long ol klaut bilong skai.
